verdict.rationale: Asking whether a terminal emulator lets users keep their data out of AI training is a fair question, since some terminals ship AI features that process user data. Nothing in kitty's evidence pack documents an AI-training policy, a training opt-out, or any statement about how user data is handled for model training. The community comment about privacy concerns over update checks is not about AI training, so it is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
